jsonLd.description:
The Everything machine is FOUR machines in 1. The EM-1 can be used for grinding, sanding, and polishing stones. It has a 6" trim saw for cutting. It features attachments for metalsmiths to create jewelry, and a flexible shaft suitable for both carving and fine metal work. The arbor and motor sits on a waterproofed veneer stand with an accessory drawer.



Additional special features include:

Moveable Sprayers

Undermount Water Filtration System

Adjustable Magnifying Lens & Light

Patented Variable Speed Motor (1 Horsepower Variable Speed with 100% Torque)



Included with purchase:

6" Bonded Diamond Wheel 60 grit

6" Bonded Diamond Wheel 220 grit

6" Resin Bond Diamond Wheel 280 grit

6" Resin Bond Diamond Wheel 600 grit

6" Resin Bond Diamond Wheel 1200 grit

6" Resin Bond Diamond Wheel 3000 grit

Flex Shaft w/ 18pc accessory set and 3pc attachment heads

x2 Silversmithing spindles w/ x3 sanding and polishing wheels

DIALUX Superfinishing paste

DIALUX Polishing paste

Flat Lap w/ 6" magnetic felt pad and 6" magnetic 80 grit disc

Magnifying Glass Attachment

Jointed Light Attachment

x2 Detachable Wrist rests

Water Pump w/ tank filtration system

Splash guards

Moss Filtration Pads

x2 Brass Spray Nozzles

Spoke Wrench

Allen Wrench/Hex key

Crescent Wrench

jsonLd.description:
AVAILABLE FOR SHIPPING, OR PICKUP IN: Wisconsin year-round, Arizona Jan/Feb



?Our SAWMASTER 24’’ Large Cutting machine from Rhino Lapidary 

is designed for cutting all kinds of materials such as gemstones, marble, ceramics, glass and granite in a fast, safe and standard way in the desired thickness. Thanks to the high technology and durable materials used in our machine, you can cut without any problems for years. 



A key feature in this machine are patented longitudinal, anti-vibration, sealed bearings which provide a wiggle-free vice. This makes your cut less prone to breaking and extensive saw-marks, even at a thickness of 1.5mm.



Cutting speed is 8mm/min (1 inch in 3 minutes). In addition, with the Auto-Feed system patented by Rhino Lapidary, when the saw gets tired or cannot cut for any reason, the vice advancement system automatically slows down and reduces the load of the saw. This extends the life of your saw. It prevents damages such as jamming and breaking caused by user errors. It also protects the motor by slowing down the cutting when necessary and prevents it from heating and burning.



In addition, the machine has an automatic stop feature for when the cutting is finished or if the cover is opened while it is working.



Fits up to a 24’’ Saw

Blade not included



Electricity: 110V 60HZ

Cutting Height: 7’’

Cutting Length: 11’’

Cutting Speed: 7/8’’/min

Motor: 1.8KW 1700rpm with crossfeed

Machine Dimensions: 105cm width x 140cm length x 140cm height

Machine Weight: 340lbs



Blade not included

All parts are CE and TSEK certified
